# Elisha and the Little Boy (2 Kings 4:35)

## Emotional Focus
Gentle kindness that brings comfort.

## Key KJV
“And he went up, and lay upon the child, and the child sneezed seven times.” (2 Kings 4:35)

## Gentle Retelling
When a little boy was very sick, Elisha prayed and God brought him back. Elisha’s gentle care showed God’s love.

## Coloring Prompt
Elisha tenderly holding a little boy who is waking up happy.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God uses kind friends to show His care.”
